acceptance.given: Rollback has completed and the Consumer Manifest contains one or more non-empty entries.

oracle.expected: For every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, the recorded post-rollback observation equals the Prior Behavior Baseline and coverage is 100%.
forbidden: Any non-empty Consumer Manifest entry lacks a post-rollback baseline observation or observes a different behavior.
oracle.observable: A machine-readable rollback verification report keyed by each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, with baseline identity comparisons and a 100% pass count.

acceptance.then: The rollback verification report proves complete baseline restoration for all non-empty entries.
acceptance.when: After rollback verification executes against the reconciled Consumer Manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise rollback with a non-empty Consumer Manifest entry whose observed behavior differs from the Prior Behavior Baseline; the verification must fail and identify that entry.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce rollback verification for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry against the Prior Behavior Baseline, requiring 100% agreement.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing manifest and rollback state formats; add only backward-compatible verification fields if required.

slice_hint.state_transition: rollback completed -> each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry verified against Prior Behavior Baseline -> acceptance only when all entries pass.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The rollback verification report covers every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry exactly once and records 100% baseline matches; any mismatch fails the obligation.

acceptance.given: A Matrix aggregate evaluation is run over the required Matrix Case and subject execution set.

oracle.expected: The aggregate passes only when every required Matrix Case input and every required subject execution is present and successful; any missing execution produces a failed aggregate.
forbidden: The aggregate passes despite a missing required Matrix Case or subject execution.
A missing Matrix Case execution is ignored.
oracle.observable: An aggregate evaluation result containing the required execution inventory, observed execution records, completeness calculation, and pass/fail verdict.

acceptance.then: The aggregate verdict is failed whenever required execution coverage is incomplete.
acceptance.when: During Matrix aggregate evaluation after execution records are collected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove one required Matrix Case subject execution from the evaluation input and run the aggregate evaluator; it must return a failed aggregate with the missing execution identified.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require complete execution coverage for all six Matrix Cases and both subjects before an aggregate can pass; report missing records explicitly.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing aggregate result schema and add completeness details without changing established success fields.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix executions collected -> required-case/subject inventory reconciled -> aggregate passes only on complete coverage; otherwise failed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate output marks failure and lists every missing required Matrix Case or subject execution; no incomplete set can be accepted.

acceptance.given: A detached Probe is executed with an infrastructure-failure false-negative condition.

oracle.expected: The Probe outcome is failed and explicitly classifies the infrastructure-failure false negative; no success verdict is emitted.
forbidden: A passing Probe outcome for an infrastructure-failure false negative.
An infrastructure failure is silently treated as a valid negative result.
oracle.observable: The detached Probe process exit/result record and parsed outcome classification showing failure due to infrastructure-failure false negative.

acceptance.then: The Probe evaluation records a failed outcome for the infrastructure-failure false negative.
acceptance.when: After the independent Probe process exits and its bound output is parsed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the detached Probe against an infrastructure-failure false-negative fixture and assert that the evaluator returns a failed Probe outcome with the infrastructure failure classification.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify infrastructure failures that would otherwise appear as false-negative Probe results as failed Probe outcomes, preserving independent-process input/output binding.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing Probe result fields and preserve an infrastructure-failure classification compatible with current consumers.

slice_hint.state_transition: Probe process launched -> infrastructure failure detected -> output classified as false negative -> failed Probe outcome emitted.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Parsed Probe result has failed status with infrastructure-failure false-negative classification; any success status for that fixture fails validation.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation receives matrix evidence that is reused across Matrix Cases or subjects.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted when evidence identity/reuse checks detect reused matrix evidence.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite reused matrix evidence.
Evidence reuse is ignored or only reported as a warning.
oracle.observable: An aggregate validation record showing evidence identity comparison, the detected reuse relationship, invalid status, and acceptance denial.

acceptance.then: The aggregate remains invalid until distinct, correctly bound matrix evidence is supplied.
acceptance.when: During aggregate evidence validation before the aggregate acceptance decision.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide two Matrix Case records referencing the same evidence identity and run aggregate validation; the validator must mark the aggregate invalid and deny acceptance.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject aggregate acceptance whenever matrix evidence identity is reused, with a deterministic invalid verdict naming the reused evidence and affected cases.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve aggregate acceptance fields and represent reuse as invalid; reused evidence cannot be accepted.

slice_hint.state_transition: Evidence records loaded -> identities compared -> reuse detected -> aggregate invalidated -> acceptance denied.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate validation output contains invalid status, a non-empty reused-evidence finding, and acceptance=false; any accepted result with reused evidence fails.
